title: JWT Token Has No Expiration Claim
description: The JWT tokens issued by the application contain only an 'iat' (issued at) claim with no 'exp' (expiration) claim. This means tokens never expire and remain valid indefinitely. A stolen or intercepted token can be used by an attacker forever without any way to invalidate it.
poc: Probe request against JWT token from POST http://127.0.0.1:3010/rest/user/login; observed proving result from prior stage handoff: POST with payload {"email":"' OR 1=1--","password":"test"} returned 200 with body containing "authentication":{"token":"eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9..."} and "umail":"admin@juice-sh.op"
